description: We are a team of enthusiastic students interested in space science, Earth science, technology and data visualization. We aim to explore creative solutions using NASA data and develop an interactive, informative project. We welcome participants with skills in coding, data analysis, graphic design, web development, research and creative thinking. Let's learn, collaborate and innovate together!
summary: Kerala Temperature Explorer is an interactive web application developed to analyse historical temperature patterns across all 14 districts of Kerala from 1981 to 2025 using NASA POWER data. It addresses the challenge of understanding large climate datasets by presenting information through interactive maps, graphs, charts and tables. Users can explore monthly and annual temperature trends, compare districts, select different year ranges and download temperature data. Developed using Python, Streamlit, Pandas and Plotly, the project makes climate information simple and accessible. It aims to create awareness about regional temperature variations and encourage better understanding of climate patterns across Kerala.
details:
KERALA TEMPERATURE EXPLORER

What does the project do and how does it work?

KERALA TEMPERATURE EXPLORER is an interactive web application designed to explore and analyse historical temperature patterns across all 14 districts of Kerala. It uses NASA POWER data covering the period from 1981 to 2025.

The website displays an interactive map of Kerala with district-wise temperature distributions using different colours. Users can select a starting and ending year, explore monthly temperature variations, view annual average temperatures and compare temperature patterns across districts. It also provides temperature summary tables and an option to download the complete dataset in CSV format.

What benefits does it have?

The project makes historical temperature data easy to understand through interactive maps, graphs and charts. It helps users identify warmer and cooler districts, observe temperature variations and understand historical climate patterns. It is useful for students, researchers and people interested in Kerala's climate.

What is the intended impact of the project?

The main aim is to create awareness about temperature variations and climate patterns across Kerala. It encourages people to explore historical climate data and supports environmental awareness and further climate-related studies.

What tools and technologies were used?

The project was developed using Python as the programming language, Streamlit for building the web application, Pandas for data processing and Plotly for interactive visualizations. NASA POWER was used as the temperature data source, and Kerala District GeoJSON was used for geographical mapping.

How is the project creative?

The project creatively combines historical temperature data, interactive maps, graphs and district-wise comparisons into a single user-friendly dashboard. Users can explore different years and districts and visualize temperature information easily.

What factors did the team consider?

Our team considered data accuracy, availability of historical records, coverage of all 14 districts, user-friendly design, clear visualizations and easy access to temperature information while developing the project.
dataRefs: 1. NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources): Monthly temperature data was retrieved using the NASA POWER API. The project uses the T2M (Temperature at 2 Meters) parameter for the 14 districts of Kerala.
